title: Debug provider registration and artifact projection need an actions contract
expected_semantics: An actions caller should invoke debugging by structured operation and receive witness/trace/replay artifacts plus existing receipt/evidence-manifest documents.
actual_behavior_limitation: The pinned actions conventions provide receipt/evidence vocabulary and a provider registry direction, but no registered mncs-debug provider exists. This repository can prepare a descriptor only; it cannot modify or register actions during the concurrent campaign.
why_capability_matters: Forge and automation need machine-stable debug artifacts and correlation rather than scraping a debugger terminal.
current_workaround: Keep a local data-only descriptor and expose the Forge-ready JSONL API; do not claim family registration.

host_language_code_required.why: Current action invocation/receipt plumbing belongs in the actions transport layer, which is outside this repository and read-only for this campaign.

proposed_primitive_or_semantic_direction: Add a registered provider contract that maps action correlation to debug-api/1 and lists each artifact digest in mncs.evidence-manifest/1 while preserving unestablished claims.
resolution_criteria: A later actions campaign registers the provider, runs a structured debug action, and verifies receipt/evidence digests against the returned witness without changing debugger semantics.
